title: Normalized embedded integral coefficient ring-sheaf diagram
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite embedded extension of Q_ell, pi a generator of the maximal ideal of its integers, and X a Noetherian scheme. Use the specified coefficients and maps of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients]. On the coefficient-sized small pro-etale site J put A=ULift(O_E), I=(pi)A. The small ring sheaves of the embedded continuous integers, discrete integers, continuous first residue and discrete first residue admit isomorphisms to the canonical completed ring, constant ring, and first finite quotient (twice), respectively. These four isomorphisms intertwine the specified constant-to-continuous scalar map, the completed first reduction, and the constant first reduction with the canonical completion, projection, and quotient maps. This asserts three commutative ring-sheaf squares, without any assertion about modules, derived categories or completeness.

proof.text: Identify the pulled-back discrete ring with the constant ring on the equivalent small site, normalized by the identical scalar sections. Identify continuous functions into each finite quotient with its constant sheaf using the finite clopen fibre covering. Transport these identifications through ULift and the quotient of the mapped principal ideal.

proof.text: Use the integral inverse-limit comparison to identify the continuous integer ring with the limit of the positive constant quotients. The normalized finite quotient identifications commute with transition maps; the limit isomorphism then preserves its first projection.

lean.statement:
theorem embeddedIntegral_coefficient_ring_diagram
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    let A := ULift.{u + 1} (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    let I : Ideal A := Ideal.map ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom (Ideal.span {π})
    let J := Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X
    ∃ (eB : IntegralModelsStacks.smallRing X (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E) ≅
        ConstantCompletion.completed J A I)
      (eR : IntegralModelsStacks.smallRing X
        (condensedRingObj (IntegralModelsEmbedded.discreteObj
          (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)) X) ≅ ConstantCompletion.constant J A)
      (eSB : IntegralModelsStacks.smallRing X
        (completedCoefficient X
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheaf (completedResidue ℓ E π 0))).X ≅
            ConstantCompletion.finite J A I 0)
      (eSR : IntegralModelsStacks.smallRing X
        (condensedRingObj (IntegralModelsEmbedded.discreteObj
          (completedResidue ℓ E π 0)) X) ≅ ConstantCompletion.finite J A I 0),
      (IntegralModelsStacks.smallMap X (IntegralModelsEmbedded.scalarMap ℓ E X) ≫ eB.hom =
        eR.hom ≫ ConstantCompletion.coefficientMap J A I) ∧
      (IntegralModelsStacks.smallMap X
        (completedCoefficientMap X (completedReduction ℓ E π 0)).hom ≫ eSB.hom =
          eB.hom ≫ ConstantCompletion.projection J A I 0) ∧
      (IntegralModelsStacks.smallMap X (IntegralModelsEmbedded.residueMap ℓ E π X) ≫
        eSR.hom = eR.hom ≫ ConstantCompletion.quotient J A I 0)
